chunks: What al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Fadalah, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb, who said:
I asked Abā 'Abdillāh عليه السلام about the tathwīb that takes place between the adhan and the iqamah, so he said: We do not recognize it.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A kunyah referring to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.التَّثْوِيبِ: A repeated call or added phrase associated with the call to prayer context
key_terms.الْأَذَانِ: The adhan, the call announcing the time of salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْإِقَامَةِ: The iqamah, the call marking the immediate commencement of salat (prayer)
key_terms.مَا نَعْرِفُهُ: An expression meaning it is not recognized or acknowledged

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about tathwīb between the adhan and the iqamah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام was asked about the tathwīb performed between the adhan and the iqamah. He replied that it was not recognized, indicating its lack of acceptance in this ritual context within Shia legal understanding.
